label: Alt Urgell i la Cerdanya
aka: Formatge de l'Alt Urgell i la Cerdanya

about.text: A cylindrical, pale-ivory cheese from the Alt Urgell and Baixa Cerdanya in the Pyrenees, made from whole pasteurised cow's milk with animal rennet and lactic ferments, and cured for up to a month. It is sold as Urgèlia from La Seu d'Urgell.
